scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.5 changes existing macOS desktop behavior in Aide, editing, and automatic updates, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.5 changes existing Windows desktop behavior in Aide, editing, and automatic updates, so the supported Windows package is required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.5 introduces the first supported Ubuntu 24.04 x64 DEB and registers Linux as an active hard-gated release platform, so the Linux package is required.
